messages.subject: LOD for assumed genetic model
messages.body_plain:
I'm working through a paper where the author assumed a specific
genetic model (dominant, recessive, additive, free) and trying to
replicate their results in r/qtl.  Does r/qtl allow the assumption of
the underlying model being tested for qtl mapping?
